text:
maria: Team — planning a 45m webinar for Apr 18. Need final topic, 2 abstracts (short + long), speaker roster, and rehearsal plan. Voting quick please.

alex: Two topic ideas from growth: 1) "Operationalizing Low-Latency Inference" 2) "Reducing Token Cost Without Sacrificing Quality". My pick is #1 for enterprise hooks.

sam: Both good. If we pick #1 I can lead on benchmarks + a short demo showing how batching impacts p99. If #2 we should surface quantization case studies.

claire: Audience segmentation: 60% PLG engineers, 30% platform/infra, 10% execs. Suggest abstract that highlights practical knobs (batching, caching, routing) and one exec-facing benefit line (cost predictability).

maria: Draft abstracts below. Please react with :one: or :two: or suggest edits.

maria: ABSTRACT A (tech-first, 45s): "Operationalizing low-latency inference: how teams keep tail latency under control at scale. Join Redwood engineers to see real-world benchmarks, routing patterns, and a live demo that shows latency SLOs under load."

maria: ABSTRACT B (cost-first, 45s): "Cut inference spend without quality loss: practical techniques for batching, quantization, and caching. We share benchmarked tradeoffs and a playbook you can apply in production."

jon: Quick poll: :one: ABSTRACT A, :two: ABSTRACT B

alex: :one:

sam: :one:

claire: :two: (leaning cost side for demand gen)

maria: Looks like A wins 3-1. We'll go with A but add one slide on cost implications.

maria: SPEAKER ROSTER draft: Host: maria (30s intro + close). Tech lead: sam (benchmark + demo). Platform example: alex (customer case / infra checks). Panel/Q&A: jon + claire. Backup speaker: liz (ops) in case sam unavailable.

sam: I'll prepare demo notes: include scripted load generator, show p50/p95/p99, and quick fallback to quantized model. Need a sandbox key that limits concurrency.

alex: I'll bring a short customer quote (anonymized) and a small diagram of smart routing rules.

jon: Lead capture questions proposal: company size (bands), role, ARR sensitivity (yes/no), interested in pilot (yes/no). High-intent filter: selects for AE assignment if "interested in pilot = yes" OR "ARR sensitivity = yes + company size > 500". UTM params: utm_source=webinar, utm_campaign=apr18-lowlatency.

claire: Post-webinar assets: recording, slides PDF, short 2-min demo clip, and a 1-page playbook. We should host playbook gated behind a form to capture MQLs.

maria: REHEARSAL plan: 30m technical run 2 days before (Apr 16 4pm PT) with full slides + demo. AV check 15m before. Dress rehearsal (full timeline) 1 day before (Apr 17 11am PT). rehearsal-bot will ping 24h and 1h before each.

rehearsal-bot: Rehearsal placeholders created: Tech run Apr 16 4:00 PM PT, Full dress Apr 17 11:00 AM PT. AV check 15 minutes prior. Invites queued.

maria: RUN-OF-SHOW (45m)
- 00:00-02:00 intro & poll (maria)
- 02:00-18:00 benchmark narrative + methodology (sam)
- 18:00-30:00 demo + failover handling (sam + alex)
- 30:00-40:00 panel Q&A (panel)
- 40:00-45:00 CTA & next steps (maria)

alex: AV/ops notes: presenters please use wired ethernet if possible. Record locally as fallback. Provide slide deck and demo creds by Apr 15 EOD. I'll verify captioning provider settings.

sam: Demo creds note: use time-limited key and deny write ops. I'll provide in a secure doc link. Also include a short script for the demo in the slides speaker notes.

jon: Routing automation: test mapping SFDC campaign -> HubSpot list -> AE queue by Apr 17 EOD. For priority leads (company size > 2000 or pilot requested) -> post summary to #sales-inbound with confetti emoji. No PII in Slack.

claire: Marketing assets timeline: registration landing + copy by Apr 8, email nurture set by Apr 12, reminder sequences (7d, 1d, 1h). Post-webinar email + survey goes out within 2 hours.

maria: A couple of open asks before signoff: 1) slide decks + demo script by Apr 15 EOD 2) rehearsal acceptances from panel by Apr 14 3) routing test complete Apr 17 EOD 4) assets + email copy ready Apr 12 noon PT

alex: I'm good with those dates. I'll upload infra diagram Apr 13.

sam: I'll add demo script and benchmarks to slides by Apr 15.

claire: I'll finalize registration page copy by Apr 8.

maria: Great. If no objections I'll lock this run-of-show and publish calendar invites. :rocket:
